source: Owner supplied two chat images 3105.jpg and 3106.jpg, inspected visually; no caliper dimensions provided yet. These image files are not yet archived in GitHub.

photo_references.view: Rear/component side of gamepad with main board and pair of shoulder switch bodies near SW2, with ruler nearby
photo_references.notes: Switch pair and ribbon paths visible; ruler perspective not sufficient for dimension extraction

photo_references.view: Joystick daughterboard reverse and partial shoulder switch assembly with ribbons
photo_references.notes: Useful to identify original ribbon routes but not orthographic/scale-certified

observations: First image shows a pair of rectangular black switch housings joined/adjacent along a central taller plastic spine; exact mechanical relationship, whether separate moving components or one bracket, needs inspection.
Each switch body has an approximately circular visible button area and a narrow green PCB solder tab projecting downward into separate white ribbon leads.
Green circuit-board tabs are much smaller than the external plastic switch housings; model full switch body and actuator envelope rather than just PCB dimensions.
Original shoulder ribbons are physically deteriorating per owner; do not require their preservation or lengths in the final model. Preserve switch circuitry and map replacement wiring.
The two shoulder assemblies may be mirror layouts. The photos do not establish identical dimensions or all mounting points.
Unrelated larger round/oval openings and traces in image 3106 belong to the joystick daughterboard; do not misassign those to the shoulder modules.

paired_switch_assembly_total_width.reference: Across both black switch housings including central plastic, in described button-front/ribbons-down orientation

paired_switch_assembly_total_height_in_p.reference: Top of black plastic to bottom of lowest green PCB tab, excluding hanging ribbons

maximum_front_back_depth.reference: From front of button actuators to rearmost assembly part, including protruding solder connections

right_button_black_housing_height.reference: Owner: 'height of the right button is 15' in context of black-plastic-only housing dimensions; exact top/bottom datum not separately supplied.

bottom_to_highest_black_plastic_piece.reference: From bottom edge of the black plastic housing to the top of the tallest central black plastic section; green PCB tabs explicitly excluded. Owner confirmed 2026-11-13.

mounting.holes_or_clips: unknown: investigate molded plastic retention and any fasteners
mounting.ribbon_origin: visible, exact distances and electrical pin identities held in existing harness records

attachment_type.value: Retaining wings are molded on the shoulder-switch assembly itself and engage original controller housing.
attachment_type.notes: Owner explicitly corrected previous ambiguity: wings are on the assembly, not molded in controller housing. Both shoulder assemblies are mirrored.

wing_geometry_mm.frame: Front view, round switch buttons facing viewer and ribbon tails down; left/right refer to this view of the representative assembly. Opposite assembly is mirrored.

left_ear.additional_geometry: Height/thickness, vertical location, projection origin, attachment orientation and whether dimensions extend outside 37 x 29 mm envelope not separately confirmed.

right_ear.extent: Full length of the black plastic switch housing; user confirmed, not just part of the raised pad.

top_offset_below_plastic_top_mm.notes: Owner says 'is 2mm lower thn the top of the plastic'; treat as vertical placement relative to plastic top, not a measured projection size or tab thickness.

length_mm.notes: Assuming wing spans full 15 mm right button black-plastic housing; owner specifically stated full length of black plastic; not a separate direct wing measurement.

right_ear.length_reference: Owner measures height of right button housing as 15 mm; because wing extends full length of black plastic on right, 15 mm is a provisional wing-span inference until the wing start/end are confirmed; the taller black plastic piece extends 23 mm from bottom.

wing_geometry_mm.note: These are retaining wings on switch assembly. Do not invent complete 3D wing outlines or enlarge owner-measured 37x29x15 envelope without reference checks.

mounting.original_housing_engagement: Retaining wings formed on both switch assemblies fit molded features of original shell, per owner; actual mating/clearance details for new shell unmeasured.

measurement_orientation.proposed_view: With both round button actuators facing camera, assembly oriented like photo 3105, solder tab/ribbon tails pointing downward.
measurement_orientation.notes: Owner should confirm whether this is a left or right shoulder assembly and measure the other separately if mirror not identical.

pending: Measure left ear location (height from assembly top) and whether 6 mm dimension is lateral span and 2 mm is front-back projection; verify whether ears are included in 37 x 29 x 15 mm envelope.
Identify photographed pair as left or right shoulder assembly based on mainboard SW1/SW2 and user confirmation.
Locate shoulder switch solder tabs, land/pad positions and available solderable area for replacement wiring; existing ribbons deteriorating.
Determine how to secure replacement wire tails to plastic housing or a support so solder joints are not load-bearing.

center_to_center_spacing_mm.reference: Between centers of the two round visible shoulder buttons, with round buttons facing observer and ribbons downward

reported_button_height_mm.notes: Owner clarified round button projects approximately 2 mm OUTWARD above surface of its black plastic housing, measured along front-to-back/Z direction. Not the button's XY center location. Already within reported 15 mm maximum total assembly depth; do not add twice.

first_actuator_center_x_from_left_edge_m.reference: Left external edge of 37 mm shoulder-switch assembly to center of left circular button; buttons toward viewer, ribbons down

center_y_from_top_edge_mm.reference: Measured down from top edge of black plastic housing to center of round shoulder actuator with buttons facing observer and ribbons pointing down. Measured at either actuator; assuming both share same height in provisional CAD, subject to verification.

protrusion_mm.reference: Round actuator face projects out from black plastic housing toward pressing finger

center_y_from_bottom_of_total_assembly_m.notes: Only applies if 29 mm assembly total height and black housing top use the same top datum; bottom is lowest PCB tab.

ribbon_condition.report: Existing shoulder-button ribbon wires are already breaking off; their lengths are not relevant as design constraints.
ribbon_condition.engineering_implication: Do not use present ribbon length or physical routing as a requirement for final layout. Design replacement/reterminated connections at the switch/PCB tabs with deliberate strain relief and route new wires to the harness. Keep the actual electrical signal/pad mapping as a separate design responsibility.
ribbon_condition.scope: Shoulder assemblies specifically (current measurement context); do not infer joystick ribbons have failed unless owner confirms.

comparison.owner_report: Left and right shoulder assemblies share the measured 37 x 29 x 15 mm external envelope and are mirrored versions of one another.
comparison.design_use: Use one parametric base assembly model mirrored for the other side; the 18.5 mm actuator spacing and 9.2 mm left offset, 7.5 mm top offset and ~2 mm protrusion apply in local mirrored assembly frames; exact switch tab orientation and retention geometry still to be localized.
